role: Gate: the structure block half (StructureStart.generateStructure per population step) against StructureBlocksProbe recordings under out/java/sblocks/<name>/: every block write, tile entity, constructed entity and 3x3 chunk hash is compared in order per step for mineshafts, temples, strongholds, villages and fortresses.

structs.name: step_rec
structs.java: one probe step: start chunk, step chunk, write count, 3x3 hash

structs.name: ent_rec
structs.java: an entity the step constructed (class, position, NBT)

structs.name: te
structs.java: tile entity snapshot row for the per-step diff

structs.name: block_half
structs.java: table row: structure type name to its native block dispatch

gpu: line 124, read_ents: malloc per entity record
notes: Test binary, not linked into the product; hazards listed are test-harness statics, not tick code. Starts come from structure_walk (structure.c), blocks from sc_generate (structure_blocks.c) over mineshaft_blocks.c/temple_blocks.c etc. Struct field lists beyond step_rec not enumerated. Recordings: out/java/sblocks (fo-*, s2-*, s42*, sh-*, te*, vi*).
